title: More community projects, clearer paths into the API
summary:
A garden-maintenance day: new community apps, cleaner docs and model access, plus safer service packaging.

Four new community apps joined the directory, while the web-search API example now points at the right model. The documentation also got a tighter Claude workflow guide, with MCP details moved somewhere they can be found without excavating a giant file.

Nectar-tier benefits now cover the gptimage model, and Claude Haiku's global usage display was corrected to use the proper per-million-unit format. Numbers: still annoyingly important when computers are involved.

Docker images are now built for the text and image services, while service secrets moved under SOPS encryption. More reproducible deployments, fewer plaintext surprises.
